report.summary: Analyzed event_to_transport_record function; claims about wrapping events and payload preservation are verified.

handoff.purpose: Define event_to_transport_record function that wraps typed events into TransportRecord.

symbols.name: event_to_transport_record
symbols.note: Converts an event object to a TransportRecord, preserving payload and generating content string.

claims.text: Wrap one typed event without discarding its provider-neutral payload.
claims.why: The function assigns payload=asdict(event) and returns a TransportRecord with that payload, so the payload is preserved.

observations.what: The function uses asdict(event) to extract payload, which works for dataclass instances; content generation uses special handling for specific event types.
